fact_text: The interviewee said a US fee of about $1,000 on H-1B visas raises the cost of on-site hiring, which may push US companies toward remote hiring from Pakistan.

fact_text: The interviewee argued that a shift from on-site to remote hiring by US firms would favour Pakistani freelancers and IT workers who already serve US clients remotely.

fact_text: The interviewee said talk exists of US IT workers moving to Europe, Dubai or China if US labour costs rise, which he saw as more work for Pakistani remote talent.

fact_text: Pakistan ranks fourth in the world by number of freelancers, according to the interviewee.

fact_text: Pakistan has about 2.37 million freelancers, the interviewee said, and their number has risen since 2023-24 as freelancing and remote work gained ground.

fact_text: The interviewee is founding president of the Global Freelancers Union, which he said represents 1.57 billion freelancers worldwide.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Should Know Before Becoming a Freelancer in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-21)

fact_text: Freelance marketplaces had more than 20,000 jobs on offer, the interviewee said, far more than the 2,000 graduates he used as an example of new job seekers.

fact_text: The interviewee said Pakistan has fewer salaried jobs than graduates, so freelancing has become a route to income for graduates who cannot find employment.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Should Know Before Becoming a Freelancer in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-21)

fact_text: The interviewee said Pakistani freelancers can earn dollar income while keeping living costs low at home, which he gave as the reason freelancing attracts workers.

fact_text: Dubai has a freelancer visa, and several European countries offer digital nomad visas, to attract remote workers who take residency and remit their earnings there.

fact_text: Dubai's Creators HQ, which the interviewee said Sheikh Mohammed set up, offers golden visas to content creators who produce their content from Dubai.

fact_text: Dubai has built a YouTube academy for creators, the interviewee said, as part of its effort to attract content creators and podcasters.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Should Know Before Becoming a Freelancer in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-21)

fact_text: The interviewee argued Pakistan should build a content-creator hub so that local influencers and creators gain benefits for producing content at home.

fact_text: Workers in traditional industries gain collective bargaining through associations, but the interviewee said remote freelancers spread across countries need a different structure to negotiate better terms.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Should Know Before Becoming a Freelancer in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-21)

fact_text: The interviewee said Pakistan's youth, women and student groups, about 10,000 associations, societies and WhatsApp groups in his count, should be merged into one freelancer union.

fact_text: The interviewee said the union would lobby governments and make policy recommendations, since few countries have a formal freelancer association.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Should Know Before Becoming a Freelancer in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-21)

fact_text: The interviewee said he met the IT minister and the Pakistan Software Export Board CEO and submitted a paper asking that platforms such as Upwork and Freelancer.com visit Pakistan.

fact_text: Upwork is a US freelance marketplace, and Freelancer.com is an Australian one, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Should Know Before Becoming a Freelancer in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-21)

fact_text: Pakistani freelancers on global platforms struggle to reach support teams because the platforms have little local presence, and accounts are sometimes blocked, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Should Know Before Becoming a Freelancer in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-21)

fact_text: PayPal is not available in Pakistan, the interviewee said, so freelancers depend on other payment providers to receive client payments.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Should Know Before Becoming a Freelancer in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-21)

fact_text: Payoneer serves Pakistani freelancers, but the interviewee said its commission can change and payments to freelancers sometimes get stuck.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Should Know Before Becoming a Freelancer in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-21)

fact_text: Global freelance marketplaces charge freelancers a 30% commission, the interviewee said, which gives them a strong incentive to keep clients on their platforms.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Should Know Before Becoming a Freelancer in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-21)

fact_text: Platforms flag and block accounts for using VPNs, changing locations often, sharing one account among several people, or moving clients off-platform to exchange phone numbers, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Should Know Before Becoming a Freelancer in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-21)

fact_text: The interviewee argued that platforms earn from the clients freelancers bring in, so they want to facilitate the work while keeping it on their own systems.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Should Know Before Becoming a Freelancer in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-21)

fact_text: About five or six Pakistani freelancers on these platforms reportedly earned around $1.5 million, the interviewee said, in a figure he gave without a clear date.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Should Know Before Becoming a Freelancer in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-21)

fact_text: About 64% of Pakistan's population is young, which the interviewee said makes the country attractive for platform investment and freelancing growth.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Should Know Before Becoming a Freelancer in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-21)

fact_text: The interviewee proposed asking platforms, through government requests, to fund internet infrastructure, support women freelancers and open local offices in Pakistan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Should Know Before Becoming a Freelancer in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-21)

fact_text: Women who want to freelance are often financially unstable and lack access to platforms, so the interviewee wants platforms to support women freelancers in Pakistan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Should Know Before Becoming a Freelancer in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-21)

fact_text: Basic freelance tasks such as PDF-to-Word conversion, Word-to-PDF conversion and PowerPoint-to-image work are disappearing, because software tools let clients do them without a freelancer.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Should Know Before Becoming a Freelancer in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-21)

fact_text: The interviewee named AI, machine learning and prompt engineering as high-demand freelance skills worldwide, because every app and website needs testing and security review.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Should Know Before Becoming a Freelancer in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-21)

fact_text: The interviewee said Pakistan has few cybersecurity experts, consultants and ethical hackers, especially in government organisations.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Should Know Before Becoming a Freelancer in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-21)

fact_text: Banks in Pakistan are required to employ cybersecurity staff, and the interviewee said apps and websites get hacked where such staff are missing.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Should Know Before Becoming a Freelancer in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-21)

fact_text: The interviewee argued that almost every business, large or small, needs a website, app or online shop to survive, which creates demand for cybersecurity, UI and UX experts.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Everything You Should Know Before Becoming a Freelancer in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-21)
